A Fresno house party erupted in violence late Friday night when a fight ended with three members of the Navy stabbed and rushed to the hospital.

The chaos broke out shortly after 11 p.m. at a home in the 4600 block of North Crystal Avenue, near Gettysburg Avenue.

Police were notified after three people were dropped at at a hospital, Fresno Police Lt. James Rossetti told The Fresno Bee.

All three of the victims werte identified as enlisted in the US Navy, ABC30 reported.

Two of the victims were listed in stable condition with injuries that were not considered life-threatening, the outlet reported. A third was listed in critical but stable condition.

Investigators determined the three victims had been involved in a fight at the party, according to Rossetti.

Police have made no arrests as the incident remains under investigation.
